intro: The Bloodstone Choker is a dark magical talisman crafted from bloodstone, originally held by the warlock mentor Gakin the Darkbinder. Stolen by a treacherous apprentice who fled to the Defias Brotherhood, it serves as a powerful ritual focus capable of piercing the void to draw forth and bind a Voidwalker.

p: Carved from bloodstone, the choker possesses the latent mystical authority required to bridge the mortal world and the twisting shadows of the Twisting Nether. Once returned to Gakin, it is immediately put to the test in the crypts beneath the tavern. A warlock must channel the choker's magic at the underground summoning circle to rip a hostile Voidwalker from the void. Only by subduing the furious entity in direct combat while wielding the talisman can a practitioner prove the willpower necessary to command such a guardian.
